knockout_reason: LOCAL_SEO_CAP violation + misaligned primary audience. Diana is a technical SEO specialist at a software development company (Cheesecake Labs) whose primary audience is developers and technical teams, NOT SEO professionals, consultants, or agencies who would purchase SEO Brasil. Her expertise is in technical SEO for digital products (React/Next.js applications, Core Web Vitals) — not in helping SEO practitioners or consultants rank their own services or clients. This is fundamentally misaligned with SEO Brasil's target customer (SEO consultants, freelancers, small agencies). Additionally, she reaches technical/developer audiences, not marketing/SEO professionals who buy SEO tools.

target_audience_fit.evidence: Diana's primary audience is software developers and technical teams at Cheesecake Labs, NOT SEO consultants, freelancers, or agencies. Her content focuses on technical SEO implementation for development teams (React/Next.js, Core Web Vitals, performance). SEO Brasil targets SEO professionals who manage rankings for clients — Diana reaches builders/developers who implement SEO, not buyers of SEO ranking tools. Audience mismatch is fundamental.

seo_relevance.evidence: While Diana has deep SEO expertise (technical SEO specialist), it is narrowly focused on developer-facing technical implementation, not on SEO tool usage, rank tracking, or optimization practices that SEO practitioners use. Technical SEO for developers ≠ SEO professional tool adoption. SEO Brasil's relevance requires an audience of people who manage SEO as a service/practice, not developers implementing SEO features.
